name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Mid-Market Account Executive
summary: Mid-market SaaS Account Executive with a full-cycle sales background (top three of 8-15 reps at Accelo, quota roughly doubling over tenure) and hands-on AI systems experience most sellers only talk about. Builds and runs the AI-driven outreach, lead-scoring, and automation workflows that generate pipeline, has sold and configured API-driven, integration-heavy software into technical, multi-stakeholder organizations, and is comfortable building the playbook rather than inheriting one.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems for service-based businesses - largely on GoHighLevel - automating lead enrichment, outreach, and appointment booking.
Break down manual marketing workflows into agent architectures with custom logic that scores a business's digital footprint and generates hyper-personalized outreach.

Built segmented cold-email outreach engines in GHL (website-visibility, missed-calls, and low-reviews campaigns) plus an automated prospect audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring a business's digital footprint to trigger personalized outreach.
Ran a free digital-footprint audit offer promoted through organic LinkedIn growth: 180+ businesses enrolled, 2 converted to paying clients - self-sourced pipeline built and run end to end.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs and continuously optimize conversion rates.
Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K) - roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled.
Consistently performed above commission floor into accelerator tiers, averaging ~$17,750/month in implementation/services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue.
Advised clients on CRM adoption, building scalable operational systems aligned to their growth stage and team structure.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle sales for a loyalty and marketing automation platform targeting SMBs - high-volume prospecting, lead qualification, and customer acquisition.
Built the consultative approach to customer retention and technology adoption that carried into later SaaS roles.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
